correctness.rationale: Independent from-scratch bitset clique enumeration of the 120 permutations with Chebyshev distance >=3 constructed 5,340 compatibility edges and exactly 192 size-ten cliques after 11,507,918 recursion nodes. The low two-symbol position map gives rigorous upper bound 10; every maximum indeed has each low-position L and high-position H two-subset exactly once, disjoint L,H, all coordinate-symbol counts 2. Enumerating f=L->H from the 192 verified codes gives exactly 60 bijections of Petersen disjointness graph, split into cycle types 6 of 2^5, 24 of 5+5, 30 of 2+8; lift multiplicities 4/2/4. Pair-distance profiles have 24,48,120 maxima respectively with spectra (30,15),(25,20),(28,17). This independent finite search is exhaustive for S5; no general-n extrapolation.
